prefix.content: For ordinary prompt regression tests in this session, use CliRunner.invoke(input=...) with a newline-terminated answer, not a patched input function or direct callback. convention.title: Feed ordinary prompt input through the runner and test the emulated echo
points: Supply a newline-terminated answer through CliRunner.invoke(input=...) and execute the real prompt path rather than patching input or bypassing the command.
Assert that captured output contains the ordinary prompt and its emulated echo of the supplied answer.
Assert the resulting greeting and successful exit status, not only the prompt echo.
convention.scope: Non-hidden Click prompt regression tests in this synthetic session; hidden-password prompts are excluded.

held_out_correction: That bypasses the prompt we agreed to test. Use the real command with runner.invoke(input="Iris\n"), and assert the prompt plus emulated answer, the greeting, and the exit status.
